fact_text: Pakistan National Shipping Corporation carries both dry bulk and liquid cargo, importing crude oil and refined products and handling exports such as iron ore, scrap and cement.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The reporter said about 75-80% of PNSC's revenue comes from liquid cargo, 15-20% from dry bulk cargo and under 1% from a small third segment called rent management.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC's FY25 sales revenue fell about 19% year on year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC's FY25 net profitability was roughly flat, up about 1% on FY24, even though revenue fell.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC's gross profit margin fell from about 41% in FY24 to 30% in FY25, mainly because it sold two vessels in Q3 FY25 and had to charter in ships, which earn thinner margins.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The reporter named cost optimisation as the main driver of PNSC's higher profitability, with direct expenses down sharply and operating costs well below those of global shipping peers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: Global freight rates, which move with world shipping conditions, rose over the period the reporter reviewed and were a major reason for PNSC's higher profitability.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The reporter said other income rose sharply in FY25 and, with stronger cash flows, supported profit when the top line was falling.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC held about PKR 70 billion in cash, which the reporter said can be used to fund its fleet expansion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC operates about 10 vessels, roughly five liquid cargo ships and five dry bulk ships.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC sold two older vessels in Q3 FY25 because they had become old, which the reporter said lowers their cost efficiency and profitability per vessel.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The reporter said return on assets is about 40% on PNSC's newer vessels, against about 10-11% on its older vessels.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: Replacing old vessels with newer ones is expected to lift PNSC's per-vessel profitability, as the reporter explained from the gap between new-vessel and old-vessel returns on assets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC ordered three new vessels, two large and one medium-range, with total capex of about USD 200 million.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The vessels PNSC ordered are about 3-4 years old, which the reporter described as a newer fleet than the older ships being sold.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC's fleet is expected to rise from 10 to about 13 vessels by the end of FY26, when the three ordered ships arrive, according to the reporter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC's stated fleet plan is to reach about 25 vessels over a longer horizon, with the reporter saying the timing depends on delivery and funding.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC is in talks with Chinese group companies on a strategic collaboration, and with Port Qasim Authority and Karachi Port Trust; the reporter said these could add vessels and berths.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The reporter expected PNSC's profitability to be challenged in the medium term because the fleet expansion will be funded through equity, debt and existing cash flow, raising financing charges.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC's revenue is largely dollar-linked, so dollar funding for new vessels is partly offset, the reporter argued, limiting the net hit from rupee depreciation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: Liquid cargo freight rates, PNSC's main revenue driver, could weaken if a Russia-Ukraine peace deal changes global freight; the reporter saw dry bulk freight rates as relatively stable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: Higher global interest rates could affect PNSC's valuation, the reporter said, because the company carries heavy debt for its fleet build-out.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC's book value was about PKR 522 per share, well above its market price of about PKR 443-447 at the time of the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC's average historical price-to-earnings multiple over 10 to 15 years was about 6.3-6.4 times, the reporter said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: On trailing 12-month earnings, PNSC's price-to-earnings ratio was about 4.3 times, which the reporter considered attractive against its history.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: Adding back depreciation of about PKR 40 per share, the reporter said cash earnings would put PNSC's price-to-earnings ratio below four times.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The reporter said the broader Pakistan stock market trades at about eight times earnings, well above PNSC's multiple.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The government holds about 88% of PNSC, but as a state-owned enterprise the company is able to decide its own procurement of future ships, which could speed up vessel additions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: PNSC paid dividends twice a year in FY23 and FY24, a pattern the reporter said investors liked, after paying only one dividend a year before.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: In Q1 FY26 PNSC paid its first-ever interim dividend, of PKR 5 per share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: Over the past 10 to 12 years, PNSC's dividend payout ratio was about 20-25%, sometimes near 30% and occasionally 33%, according to the reporter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The reporter estimated FY26 earnings of about PKR 80, a roughly 20% decline from about PKR 100 in FY25.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: Applying the historical payout ratio to about PKR 80 of FY26 earnings, the reporter estimated a full-year FY26 dividend of about PKR 20 per share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: Management has said it will pay dividends despite its expansion plans, and the reporter said PNSC could move to a quarterly dividend, though some quarters may be skipped.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'PNSC’s Bold Fleet Expansion Story | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)
